# ExceptionExtensions

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Diagnostics` · class

```csharp
public static class ExceptionExtensions
```

Extensions for tagging exceptions with a stable `uint` identifier that pinpoints the throwing call site without relying on reflection or symbol resolution.

## Methods

### WithTag

```csharp
public static TException WithTag<TException>(this TException exception, uint tag) where TException : Exception
```

Stamps a per-call-site `tag` onto an exception so it survives transport through any logger or telemetry sink. The tag is stored in `Exception.HResult`, which is preserved by every standard serializer and rethrow path and is reflection-free.
